description:
There has become a distinct lack of true cross race bikes in the industry, the Full Wolf helps fix that. It's a full gas cross rocket, tall BB, short rear end, and designed to get you from the start line to the podium as quickly as possible. It's got tons of mud clearance and with the optional Rocker Dropouts allows you to race geared or singlespeed and adjust your rear end for more stability or muck clearance. Many riders choose to add on some features to flex the Wolf into bad weather gravel days as well.

These are available in standard geometry or custom and with whatever paint job you so desire. We also build them with a number of options such as single speed capable dropouts.

*The bike pictured here belongs to our founder Jeff, and was created to be his CX race bike as well as Tracklocross and muddy gravel bike. As such he added the Rocker Dropouts, zip tie cable guides (to quickly remove all brakes for Tracklocross), added a third bottle mount under the DT and a top tube feedbag mount.

GEOMETRY
Cross Race Geometry with a tall bottom bracket and short chainstays for optimal quick handling, pedal clearance on off-camber sections, and efficient power transmission during sprints.

TUBING
A mix of Reynolds 853 and Columbus Life for the top and downtube. The seat stays and seat tube are custom designs from Fairing and the tapered head tube and chainstays (also a proprietary design) are sourced from Nova Cycles.

FRAME SPEC

Handbuilt in the USA

Enve Gravel Fork

Includes copper, handcrafted, Jen Green headbadge

Clearance for 700 x 45c tires

Two Bottle Mounts

UDH Compatible

Tapered head tube with external cup: EC34/44

68mm bottom bracket shell

Flat mount brake

Rear Thru Axle M12 X 1.5

Cable Guides: Paragon Modular guides under the downtube, and full loop braze-ons on the stays (No Zip Ties)

Popular Add Ons

Sliding Dropouts for Single Speed

Third water bottle mount

Top Tube feedbag mount

COMPLETE BIKE BUILD

We work with all the major component suppliers in the industry and would love to build you a complete bike. Contact us to get started.

GO CUSTOM

If your fit needs aren't met by our stock offered geo or you're looking for a custom color, material or finish, we're always happy to work with you to create the Full Wolf of your dreams.

Wilde is proud to work with a variety of experts in anodizing, Cerakote, powder coating, and wet paint to achieve any finish you desire.

Contact us to go custom.

AVAILABILITY

The Full Wolf Cyclocross bike is made to order. Delivery is around three months. Contact us for availability.

SAFETY

Please read the bicycle owners manual before riding. This is important for safe operation of your new bike.
Bicycle Owners Manual
